rounds.text: Bhudevi Infra Projects Ltd demonstrates exceptional profitability and capital efficiency, anchored by a multi-year median return on equity of 64% and an extraordinary trailing twelve-month profit growth of 203% [E19, E22]. The business operates with remarkable profitability relative to its peers, showcasing an ROE of 89.66% against a sector benchmark of 4.78% and an ROA of 4.04% compared to the sector's 1.78% [E8, E9]. Long-term top-line expansion is robust, evidenced by a compounded sales growth rate of 424% over three years [E14], while earnings acceleration is further confirmed by net profit surging 92% year-on-year [E46]. Market sentiment has severely lagged behind these fundamental improvements, leaving the stock sitting at 0% of its 52-week range despite results scoring 81 out of 100 [E5, E52]. Furthermore, debt is actively being reduced, with borrowings decreasing to Rs 8.68 Cr from Rs 9.08 Cr a year earlier [E31], and the stock trades roughly in line with its discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 54 [E35]. Conceded: [E27, E28, E29, E30] Operating cash flow is negative at Rs -1.99 Cr with a weak cash conversion ratio of -16.58x, and leverage is elevated with a debt-to-equity ratio of 12.40x.
